source.title: Some problems on numerical homotopy invariants

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL. The zbMATH web page was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge for direct shell fetching, so the zbMATH REST API was queried for identifier 3376431.

zbMATH API metadata identified Zbl 0237.55009: Tudor Ganea, Some problems on numerical homotopy invariants, Symposium on Algebraic Topology 1971, Lecture Notes in Mathematics 249, pages 23-30, DOI 10.1007/BFb0060892. This metadata was used only for source identification and title recovery.

The DOI resolved to the Springer chapter page https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/BFb0060892. That page presented the chapter as subscription preview content and did not expose the problem statements as readable full text. Direct PDF access redirected through Springer identity/session flow and did not provide a full readable artifact.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched for the exact title with PDF, the exact title with author, and the DOI. Candidate results were metadata pages, citations, later papers referencing individual Ganea problems, or non-primary summary pages; none provided a readable exact-work full-text source containing the original problem statements.

No candidates were extracted because the recovered sources were metadata-only, restricted, preview-only, or secondary references. Extracting from abstracts, search snippets, citations, or later-paper summaries would violate the source adequacy and evidence coverage gates.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/3376431.json and outputs/latest.json.
